description: Create the backend POST /api/support endpoint. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 (Android) and must be completed first so the Android feature has a real endpoint to call.
steps: Create 'c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\controller\supportController.js'. This is an ES module file. Export one named async function: 'export const submitSupportRequest = async (req, res) => { ... }'. Inside: (1) destructure subject, category, description, orderNumber from req.body; (2) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'subject, category, and description are required.' }) if subject is falsy, category is falsy, or description.length < 20; (3) get userName and userEmail from req.user (protectRoute populates req.user — use req.user.fullname || req.user.name || req.user.username for the name and req.user.email for the email); (4) build adminHtml: an HTML email in the HookaDrop dark theme (background #0A0A0A, card background #111, accent #FFD000, text #CCCCCC) listing all fields: Subject, Category, Description, Order Number (if provided), submitted by (user name + email); (5) build confirmHtml: a simpler confirmation email to the user saying their request was received and the team will reply within 24 hours; (6) import { mailSender } from '../controller/mailerSender.js'; (7) await mailSender('hookadrop@gmail.com', 'New Support Request: ' + subject, adminHtml); (8) call mailSender(userEmail, 'We received your request — HookaDrop Support', confirmHtml) without await (fire-and-forget, wrap in .catch() to log errors); (9) return res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Support request received. We\'ll get back to you within 24 hours.' }); wrap the whole thing in try/catch and return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to send support email. Please try again.' }) on catch.

Create 'c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\routes\support.js'. ES module file. Import express, protectRoute from '../middleware/protectRoute.js', and submitSupportRequest from '../controller/supportController.js'. Define router = express.Router(). Register router.post('/', protectRoute, submitSupportRequest). Export default router.

Modify 'c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\server.js'. Add import line: 'import supportRoutes from "./routes/support.js";' alongside the existing route imports (after line importing promotionRoutes). Add mount line: 'app.use("/api/support", supportRoutes);' after the existing 'app.use("/api/promotions", promotionRoutes);' line.
